name: spx-stats-ops
description: Everyday Mac jobs for this project, run from the repo root: pnpm run <name>. The site itself lives in web/.

scripts.pull: git pull -q --ff-only origin main && git log --oneline -1
scripts.preview:update: git pull -q --ff-only origin main && bash scripts/mac/ds1-preview.sh --update
scripts.deploy: git pull -q --ff-only origin main && bash scripts/mac/deploy-prebuilt.sh
